jobs.description:
About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Senior People Generalist and are actively reviewing applications.

At Ferrero, we believe that every employee is key to the success of the company, and it is our collective energy that allows us to grow our business and explore new frontiers. Within the US, our Commercial Human Resources team is dedicated to continuing to push this mission through our cyclical People & Organization (P&O) processes, strategizing with our function leaders, initiating new employee experiences, and more. The position will be part of the North America P&O Supporting Functions, Chicago and Retail team supporting and leading P&O activities/projects across the Chicago based functions and be the P&O point of reference for the Chicago office. The position will report to the P&O VP and be based in Chicago, IL.

Main Responsibilities:

Employee Relations:
•    Provides day-to-day performance management guidance to line management (e.g., coaching, counseling, career development, disciplinary actions).
•    Works with the business to identify performance gaps for employees/teams and provides applicable trainings/internal connections that will support closing these gaps.
•    Manages all Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) by supporting line managers on discussions, employees on actionable items for improvement, and meeting legal requirements.
•    Strategizes with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
•    Manages and resolves complex employee relations issues - conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations.

Project Management:
•    Responsible for the development and planning of the Chicago PBP related projects, ensuring: adherence to plan, risks/issues management, stakeholders involvement and status updates to Steering Committee
•    Coordinates all the workstreams of the project, ensuring best practices sharing across teams
•    In charge of developing the Change Management Plan with appropriate involvement from all stakeholders

P&O routine:
•    Plans, lead, direct, develop and coordinate policies, activities, and staff of the immediate team, ensuring compliance and implementation of the organization’s mission and talent strategy.
•    Manages and facilitates performance cycles across all teams under scope, ensuring consistency in application of the process and probing when necessary.
•    Assists international employees with expatriate assignments and related P&O matters.
•    Manages and facilitates succession planning sessions, utilizing outcomes throughout recruitment processes to support retention and employee career experiences.
•    Facilitates Salary Review processes with Line Managers while staying within budgetary limits and ensuring internal equity across the organization.
•    Analyzes all performance, succession planning and salary review data to ensure fairness against D&I initiatives.
•    Reflects and strategizes on all P&O-related processes through analysis and discussions, to find gaps in current process and provide solutions that would best work for the business.
•    Supports the business by being an advocate of their needs through recruitment, regrading of roles, budget and headcount planning.
•    Supports company-wide and local feedback survey launches, analyzes data that’s available and provides paths for applicable solutions.
•    Identifies training needs for business units and individual executive coaching needs.
•    Participates in evaluation and monitoring of training programs to ensure success. Follows up to ensure training objectives are met.

Leadership Support:
•    Identifies underlying issues through conversations and provides feedback/possible solutions.
•    Gains confidence and trust from leadership and teams through honesty, integrity and authenticity.
•    Anticipates P&O-related needs on teams and brings awareness to leadership before needs turn into engagement issues.
•    Seeks to understand functional roles, team interactions, and initiatives to best support teams through recruitment processes, ad-hoc requests and provide best solutions.
•    Highlights external P&O trends to leaders for awareness.
•    Close partnership with all channels/client groups to understand the business and drive strategic P&O change if needed.
•    Provides guidance and input on business unit restructures, workforce planning and succession planning.

About You:

•    Bachelor’s Degree, M.B.A./M.S./M.A. preferred
•    A minimum of 5 years of relevant knowledge, resolving complex employee relations issues and providing consultative guidance to management.
•    Working knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines. Including compensation practices, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, diversity, performance management, and federal and state employment law.
•    Experience within the consumer goods industry is a plus.
•    Experience working with global business partners.
•    Strong business acumen, analytical and relational abilities
•    Executive presence and ability to influence at varying levels across the organization
•    Ability to build a consultative relationship with senior level managers and a collaborative working relationship within the P&O team
•    Strong accountability, problem solving and innovative thinking
•    Excellent communication skills
•    Ability to find the correct balance between demand and capacity within establishing priorities for the organization
•    Strong time management skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a matrixed environment
•    Ability to collaborate across the P&O department, by sharing best practices, recent learnings, external trends and working together on P&O related projects.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Manager - IT, Professional Services & Benefits
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Senior Procurement Manager – IT, Professional Services & Benefits and are actively reviewing applications.

Reporting to the Head of General Procurement, North America, the Senior Procurement Manager will lead strategic sourcing initiatives across IT, Professional Services, and Employee Benefits. This role is responsible for driving stategic procurement activities, leading supplier negotiations, managing key supplier relationships, and delivering value through cost optimization, risk management, innovation, and operational excellence.

Partnering closely with IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and business leaders, you will drive strategic sourcing projects, contract negotiations, supplier performance management, and procurement best practices across North America. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in indirect procurement, category management, stakeholder engagement, and supplier relationship management within a complex, matrixed organization.

This position is hybrid, and will be based in our North American HQ in Parsippany, NJ.

Main Responsibilities:

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

- Develop and execute category strategies across IT, Professional Services, and Benefits that drive cost savings, service improvements, working capital optimization, supplier innovation, and operational excellence.

- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives, including supplier evaluations, spend analysis, market assessments, supplier consolidation, and regional sourcing projects.

- Monitor market trends, supplier capabilities, pricing dynamics, and emerging technologies to identify value creation opportunities and mitigate risk.

- Drive continuous improvement and procurement best practices across assigned categories.

Supplier Relationship Management & Contract Negotiation

- Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including RFI/RFP/RFQ processes, supplier selection, contract negotiations, and rate card management.

- Negotiate agreements that maximize value while balancing total cost of ownership (TCO), service levels, quality, innovation, and risk.

- Manage supplier relationships through supplier segmentation, business reviews, KPI tracking, SLA compliance, and supplier risk assessments.

- Monitor supplier performance, financial stability, and compliance to maintain a resilient, high-performing supplier portfolio.

Stakeholder Partnership & Business Engagement

- Partner with Technology, HR, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to align procurement strategies with business objectives and deliver sourcing solutions that meet evolving business needs.

- Collaborate with global and regional procurement teams to execute sourcing strategies, share best practices, and support enterprise-wide initiatives.

Procurement Governance & Value Delivery

- Manage contract lifecycle activities, ensuring appropriate contract coverage, utilization, compliance, and supplier governance.

- Track and report procurement savings, working capital improvements, supplier performance, and overall value creation.

- Support procurement operations, including purchase order and supplier master data processes, as needed.

- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls, governance standards, and corporate procedures.

About You:

Required Experience

- 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, or supply management.

- Proven expertise in category strategy development, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, supplier performance management, and spend optimization.

- Strong knowledge of sourcing methodologies, including RFI, RFP, RFQ, supplier evaluation, market analysis, risk management, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis, and reporting.

- Experience leading cross-functional sourcing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across multiple business functions.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience sourcing one or more of the following categories: Information Technology, Software/SaaS, Cloud Services, Professional Services, Employee Benefits, Consulting Services, or Managed Services.

- Experience working within a global, matrixed, or multicultural organization.

- Knowledge of SAP and SAP Ariba.

Education

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Engineering, Legal Studies, or a related discipline.

Preferred

- Master's degree (MBA or related field).

- Professional procurement or supply chain certification (CPSM, CPM, CIPS, CSCP, CPIM, or equivalent).

Leadership & Competencies

- Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and change management skills, with the ability to build partnerships across business functions and supplier organizations.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations and influence decision-making at multiple levels of the organization.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities with exceptional attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Proven ability to establish and maintain collaborative working relationships across cross-functional, regional, and global teams.

About the Role:

For our Ferrero HQ in Luxembourg, we are looking for a Supply Chain Digital Transformation Manager, reporting directly to the Head of Logistics Development, to help translate Ferrero's Supply Chain digital vision into scalable transformation programs and tangible business value.

This role will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Supply Chain operations by driving digital innovation, data-driven transformation, and AI adoption across core logistics domains, including Customs, Warehousing, Transportation, and Network Design.

Working at the intersection of business, operations, and technology, you will shape and orchestrate the Supply Chain digital roadmap, helping identify, prioritize, and accelerate high-impact transformation opportunities across the logistics landscape. In partnership with Supply Chain, IT, Data & AI, and external stakeholders, you will help translate operational challenges into scalable digital solutions, foster adoption of new ways of working, and contribute to building a more connected, intelligent, and data-driven Supply Chain.

Main Responsibilities:

In this role, you will act as a key enabler of Supply Chain digital transformation, helping connect business priorities, digital initiatives, and emerging technologies to create measurable value across Ferrero's global logistics network.

Driving the Supply Chain Digital Roadmap, you will contribute to the definition, prioritization, governance, and continuous evolution of digital initiatives across key logistics domains, including Customs, Warehousing, Transportation, and Network Design.

Working closely with Logistics Development leadership, digitalization stream owners, business stakeholders, IT, and Data & AI teams, you will help align business priorities, technology investments, and long-term transformation objectives. You will also facilitate the identification of high-impact opportunities and promote cross-functional collaboration to ensure digital initiatives support Ferrero's Supply Chain strategy.

Orchestrating Digital & AI Transformation Across Logistics Domains, you will act as the orchestrator of Supply Chain digital transformation within Logistics Development, fostering alignment and synergies across multiple digitalization streams and logistics domains.

Working closely with domain digitalization owners, business stakeholders, IT, Data & AI teams, and external partners, you will help connect initiatives, identify opportunities for scalability and reuse, and translate business needs into transformation opportunities that deliver measurable operational impact and business value.

As a functional digital leader, you will champion the adoption of AI, advanced analytics, autonomous operations concepts, digital twins, and simulation tools, helping translate emerging technologies into practical business applications that enhance operational performance and decision-making.

You will also monitor external trends, technology developments, and industry best practices, bringing innovation perspectives that help shape the future evolution of Ferrero's digital logistics capabilities.

Supporting the evolution of the Supply Chain Control Tower, you will contribute to strengthening end-to-end visibility and enabling more proactive decision-making across logistics operations.

Working with business and technology teams, you will support the definition of operational KPIs, performance metrics, and digital dashboards, while promoting the use of advanced analytics and AI-enabled insights to enhance monitoring, exception management, and decision-support capabilities. Through these activities, you will help accelerate the transition toward a more connected, intelligent, and data-driven Supply Chain.

Collaborating across a global ecosystem, you will work closely with Supply Chain functions, Data & AI teams, IT partners, technology vendors, and regional operations to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and the successful deployment of digital initiatives across Ferrero's global network.

You will foster strong stakeholder engagement, encourage collaboration between business and technology teams, and help embed digital capabilities into day-to-day operations.

You have experience leading or contributing to digital transformation initiatives, governance activities, and cross-functional programs, working across business, operations, data, and technology teams. You t ranslate operational challenges into scalable digital solutions, engaging stakeholders effectively while driving alignment across multiple transformation streams.

You bring solid knowledge of logistics processes, such as Warehousing, Transportation, Customs, or Network Design . Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, automation, machine learning technologies, Supply Chain Control Towers, digital twins, and platforms such as Blue Yonder or Coupa will support your success in this role.

Fluent in English and comfortable working in a multicultural environment, you combine strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills. You collaborate with IT, Data & AI teams, technology partners, and external providers to deliver business-driven digital solutions.

jobs.description:
About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Director, Business Strategy & Planning and are actively reviewing applications.

The Director, Business Strategy & Planning plays a central role in shaping Ferrero North America’s business priorities and translating them into plans, decisions, and action. Reporting to the SVP of Strategy & Planning, this role works closely with North America leaders and global stakeholders on strategic planning, business performance, executive communications, and cross-functional initiatives.

This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role. The Director will bring structure and insight to complex business questions while personally developing the presentations, written content, and analysis needed for senior leadership discussions. Success requires someone who can be a thought partner to executives, work effectively across functions, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-moving environment.

Main Responsibilities:

- Drive the North America strategic planning process in alignment with global timelines, working across functions to shape priorities, synthesize inputs, develop recommendations, and deliver planning materials and presentations.

- Help translate the strategic plan into action through leadership routines, clear milestones, performance measures, and follow-up on key decisions and commitments.

- Develop executive presentations and written content for North America and global leadership forums, including town halls, business reviews, and presentations for the Chief Business Officer. Structure the story, write the content, and turn complex inputs into clear messages and recommendations.

- Prepare for and support sensitive, high-visibility meetings with senior North America and global leaders, partnering with the SVP of Strategy & Planning to anticipate questions, align stakeholders, and ensure materials are ready for discussion and decision.

- Develop and refine executive scorecards and reporting that provide a clear view of business performance, progress against priorities, and emerging risks or opportunities.

- Analyze financial, commercial, market, and operational information to identify trends, evaluate gaps, and recommend actions.

- Lead or support cross-functional strategic initiatives, helping teams define the work, manage milestones and dependencies, resolve issues, and deliver outcomes.

- Identify and help implement process improvements that strengthen planning, decision-making, and execution across the business.

- Bring relevant market, competitor, and industry insights into planning and leadership discussions.

About You:

- A bachelor’s degree in business, management, finance, or a related field; an MBA or other relevant advanced degree is strongly preferred.

-
Experience in a large global and matrixed consumer packaged goods company desirable

- Experience in strategic planning, business strategy, business operations, or a related field, with a demonstrated ability to move from analysis and recommendations to execution. Strategy consulting experience is strongly preferred.

- Experience working with senior executives and across functions, ideally in a complex organization with global stakeholders.

About the Role:

As Brand Manager , you will be responsible for shaping the future of some of Ferrero’s most iconic brands in the local market. You will transform global strategies into impactful local initiatives, turning consumer insights into effective marketing plans, communication campaigns and activation programs that strengthen brand equity and drive business results. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Finance, Market Research and Supply Chain, you will lead projects from idea to execution , ensuring that every initiative contributes to brand growth , consumer engagement and commercial success. This role offers the opportunity to influence strategic decisions, manage investments and bring innovative ideas to life while delivering sustainable business performance.

Main Responsibilities:

As Brand Manager, you will contribute to the development and execution of long-term brand strategies and annual marketing plans , ensuring that global and regional priorities are translated into relevant and impactful local initiatives. By leveraging market, consumer, shopper and business insights , you will identify growth opportunities, monitor category dynamics and competitive activity, and transform findings into actionable recommendations that strengthen brand performance and drive sustainable growth. You will lead and coordinate market, consumer and shopper research initiatives, working with internal and external partners to generate meaningful insights and assess the effectiveness of marketing activities. Through continuous analysis of consumer behaviour, brand performance, market trends and competitive developments, you will translate findings into recommendations that support brand growth and business objectives.
You will manage key elements of the marketing mix , including brand positioning, communication, media, promotions, portfolio development and packaging initiatives. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, you will develop communication campaigns and consumer activations, prepare agency briefs, coordinate creative, media and research agencies, and oversee the delivery of marketing materials that effectively support brand objectives while remaining aligned with both local market needs and global brand guidelines. A central part of the role will be developing and managing consumer activation and promotional initiatives , ensuring alignment with brand strategy and business objectives. In close collaboration with Trade Marketing and Sales, you will contribute to the development of promotional programs, assess campaign effectiveness using sales and market performance indicators, identify opportunities for optimization and translate learnings into future growth initiatives. You will also manage the brand portfolio , including product launches, seasonal initiatives, packaging adaptations and artwork development, ensuring compliance with local regulations and internal processes. Through continuous analysis of brand performance, market share, distribution, pricing and consumer trends, you will help shape recommendations that support long-term business success.
In partnership with Trade Marketing and Sales, you will contribute to demand and sales planning processes , supporting volume forecasting activities, monitoring performance against targets and identifying opportunities to improve business results. You will help ensure alignment between marketing plans, commercial objectives and brand growth ambitions. In addition, you will contribute to budget planning and performance management , monitoring marketing investments, promotional spending, research costs and overall brand profitability. You will identify risks and opportunities, recommend corrective actions and ensure resources are allocated effectively to achieve business objectives.
Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Market Research, regional and global teams, as well as external agencies and suppliers. You will lead and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, manage timelines, approvals and reporting requirements, prepare presentations that communicate brand plans, business performance and key recommendations to stakeholders, and ensure accurate project documentation and data management within internal systems and reporting tools. A university degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics or a related field is preferred. Advanced English language skills are required, along with solid proficiency in MS Office applications , particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Experience working with SAP is considered an advantage.
You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, enabling you to navigate complex situations and make data-driven recommendations. At the same time, you are highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
You are an excellent communicator who can build strong relationships across functions and influence decisions through clear and compelling presentations. A collaborative mindset, flexibility and resilience under pressure are essential for success in this role.

Lead the commercial management of the D2C portfolio, ensuring our core, seasonal, exclusive and service propositions remain differentiated, competitive and commercially successful. Strong analytical and commercial skills will enable you to interpret performance, identify opportunities and translate insight into clear actions. You’ll understand how commercial decisions influence the wider consumer experience and bring strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across commercial, marketing, supply chain and operational teams.

jobs.title: Plant PMO, Performance & Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role:

Ferrero is looking for an experienced Plant PMO, Performance & Continuous Improvement Manager to play a pivotal role in driving performance, transformation and continuous improvement across our manufacturing operation.

Working closely with the Plant Manager and Plant Leadership Team , you will sit at the heart of the site, connecting strategy with execution and ensuring our key priorities translate into measurable and sustainable improvements.

This is a broad and influential role that goes beyond traditional PMO. You will bring together plant governance, performance management, major cross-functional projects, Continuous Improvement and digitalisation , providing the structure, challenge and leadership needed to accelerate the Plant's transformation agenda.

You will also play a leading role in developing our Smart Factory ambitions, identifying how technology, data and new ways of working can improve operational performance while ensuring that people remain at the centre of change.

For someone passionate about Operational Excellence, manufacturing transformation and creating a culture of continuous improvement , this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact across an entire manufacturing site.

Main Responsibilities:

As Plant PMO, Performance & Continuous Improvement Manager, you will work alongside the Plant Manager to establish strong governance across the site, coordinating priorities and ensuring effective collaboration between Plant departments. You will support the development of the Plant Master Plan , translating strategic priorities into a clear longer-term roadmap and monitoring progress against key initiatives.

You will coordinate the Plant budget process and performance follow-up, bringing together information from across the operation to provide visibility of performance, highlight priorities and support effective decision-making.

Acting as Project Manager for major cross-functional initiatives, you will provide leadership and structure to complex projects from planning through to implementation. Alongside delivering projects directly, you will help strengthen project management capability and ways of working across the Plant.

A major focus will be driving the site's  Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence agenda . You will champion Ferrero's improvement methodologies, working closely with operational teams to identify opportunities, develop improvement plans and ensure initiatives translate into measurable and sustainable performance improvements.

You will coach and develop colleagues in Continuous Improvement methodologies, helping build capability across the organisation and creating greater ownership of performance improvement within line and functional teams.

Alongside this, you will lead the Plant's Smart Factory and digitalisation initiatives , working with local and wider Ferrero teams to identify, prioritise and deploy digital solutions that can improve the way we operate. You will monitor progress and ensure technology and data are being translated into meaningful operational value.

Through all of these activities, you will act as a key connector across the Plant, bringing together Operations, Maintenance and other functions while collaborating with wider Industrial & Supply teams to ensure local priorities remain aligned with the broader organisation.

About You:

You will be an experienced Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Transformation, PMO or Performance professional , with a strong track record of delivering change within a manufacturing or similarly complex operational environment.

You will understand how to turn strategy into practical execution and will be comfortable operating across multiple functions, priorities and projects. Strong project and programme management capability will be important, together with experience of driving measurable performance improvement.

You will bring a strong understanding of Continuous Improvement and Lean methodologies , with the ability not only to apply improvement tools yourself but to engage, coach and influence others to adopt new ways of working.

Experience of Smart Factory, manufacturing digitalisation, Industry 4.0 or data-led performance improvement would be highly valuable, particularly where you have helped translate technology into tangible operational benefits.

Analytically strong and commercially aware, you will be comfortable working with performance measures, budgets and complex information, using insight to identify opportunities and support effective decision-making.

Just as importantly, you will be a strong communicator and change leader. You will be able to build credibility from the shop floor through to senior leadership, challenge constructively and bring different stakeholders together around a common objective.

Above all, you will combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to delivery . You will be passionate about improving performance, developing capability and creating sustainable change within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager - 6 month contract
jobs.description:
About the Role:

The Assistant Brand Manager will support the development and execution of marketing initiatives for an established portfolio across Southeast Asia, Hong Kong and Taiwan. This role will contribute to locally relevant campaigns, portfolio initiatives and integrated marketing plans designed to drive brand growth, consumer engagement and new consumption occasions. The position offers broad exposure across the marketing mix, including strategic planning, campaign execution, performance analysis, innovation, packaging and budget management.

The role is offered on a 6 months contract with Ferrero.

Main Responsibilities:

- Support the development of annual brand plans based on brand positioning, consumer insights and local market dynamics

- Help translate regional and global brand strategies into locally relevant growth initiatives

- Contribute to strategic planning discussions, presentations and recommendations for brand investment

- Establish clear objectives and measures of success for key brand activities

- Plan, coordinate and execute integrated brand campaigns across multiple markets

- Manage agency relationships throughout the campaign process, from briefing and development through to execution and evaluation

- Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver campaigns effectively, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and identify opportunities for improvement

Working closely with Sales, Finance and Category teams, you will provide constructive challenge and recommendations that support stronger commercial decision-making and maximise value creation.

About the Role:

You will lead the development of Ferrero’s global logistics automation strategy, helping transform warehouses, manufacturing plants and distribution centres through advanced automation, data and digital supply chain solutions.

From strategic assessment and concept design to implementation, commissioning and benefits realization, you will connect long-term direction with practical delivery. Your work will improve productivity, capacity, service and operational efficiency across international operations.

As a senior subject matter expert, you will shape warehouse transformation standards, influence investment decisions and support wider end-to-end supply chain digitalization initiatives, including artificial intelligence, advanced analytics and data-driven decision-making.

Main Responsibilities:

You will define the global logistics automation roadmap and identify where technology can create measurable operational value. You will lead feasibility studies and warehouse assessments, collaborate on automated material flows and layouts, and use throughput analysis, simulation modelling and capacity planning to guide robust solution choices.

You will lead complex capital programs through governance, schedules, budgets and risk management, coordinating suppliers, system integrators and engineering partners. You will support the definition of functional and technical specifications, oversee commissioning and operational handover, and track whether expected business benefits are achieved after go-live.

You will build credible investment dossiers and business cases, supporting return-on-investment, net-present-value, internal-rate-of-return and total-cost-of-ownership analysis. Alongside Finance and Procurement, you will contribute to negotiations and lifecycle-cost decisions while balancing performance, reliability and long-term operational efficiency.

You will also lead the Global Warehouse subject-matter-expert community, share best practices and coach regional teams on automation opportunities. Your technology scope may include automated storage and retrieval systems, shuttle systems, conveyors, sorters, autonomous vehicles, robotics, automated loading, warehouse management and control systems, SAP EWM and digital twins.

About You:

You bring at least 10 years of relevant experience in logistics engineering, intralogistics, warehouse development, automation engineering or supply chain transformation, with evidence of leading complex implementations across multiple locations or geographies.

You combine hands-on knowledge of automated warehousing and material-handling technologies with strong program, financial and managerial capability. You can translate technical choices into clear business cases and communicate effectively with executives, operational teams and external partners.

About the Role:

As a  Trade Marketing Specialist , you will play a key role in supporting Ferrero’s in-store activation strategy for retailers and key accounts. You will be responsible for planning, coordinating and executing promotional and POS activities for assigned customers, with a strong focus on shopper-oriented activations, visibility and impactful in-store presence .

Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Key Account Management, Supply Chain, Finance and external partners, you will manage trade marketing activities from planning and development through execution, monitoring and evaluation. You will also contribute to channel development initiatives, new in-store opportunities and key projects across priority channels such as Out of Home and Ice Cream .

This role offers the opportunity to work with Ferrero’s iconic brands in a dynamic FMCG environment, combining strategic thinking, commercial understanding and hands-on execution .

Your Key Responsibilities

Drive in-store activation and channel development: Support the In-store Activation Manager in key projects and taskforces, while coordinating in-store team-related activities and monitoring progress. Identify new in-store opportunities with existing and potential partners, develop new events and contribute to new ways of working across priority channels and categories.

Develop customer and channel plans: Plan and execute shopper-oriented activities that increase Ferrero’s visibility and strengthen its presence at the point of sale. Develop customer-specific promotional concepts and annual promotional calendars by brand and category, aligned with market needs and strategic business objectives.

Support KAMs and cross-functional execution: Support Key Account Managers in the elaboration and implementation of annual in-store activation calendars, related customer-specific analyses. Coordinate internal information flows and timelines between Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain and Finance to ensure the smooth execution of in-store activities.

Develop and manage POS materials and other tools that support brand visibility and memorability on store level: Work closely with Marketing on the development of POS concepts and materials, including feasibility and cost analysis. Estimate required quantities and coordinate the presentation, rollout and feedback collection of materials with relevant functions, including the field force and merchandisers.

Plan and execute promotional and in-store activities: Develop and coordinate secondary placements, promotional and tailor-made activities, hostess activities, incentives and events at POS level. Ensure activities are implemented effectively and in line with internal processes and requirements, from planning through execution.

Monitor and evaluate in-store execution: Monitor and report on activity execution through store checks, field force reporting and quantitative and qualitative information gathered from Sales. Collect structured feedback from relevant departments, evaluate completed activities and prepare regular analyses and presentations to identify learnings and improvement opportunities.

Identify business opportunities and manage budgets: Identify potential by brand, category and customer, as well as opportunities to increase turnover and profitability for both Ferrero and its retail partners. Support annual Trade Marketing budget planning and monitor monthly costs against budget and agreed plans.

Manage POS operations and external partners : Coordinate the operational purchasing of POS materials, ensuring timely production and delivery to Ferrero warehouses and the sales force. Support POS stock management and administration, while coordinating with external suppliers and hostess agencies, monitoring execution, service quality and costs.

Coordinate information and stakeholders: Collect, consolidate and share relevant information related to promotional activities, catalogues, photos, leaflets, sales force information, POS placement standards and partner incentives. Participate in client meetings and ensure effective collaboration across internal and external stakeholders.

- 3+ years of relevant professional experience, in Trade Marketing, In-store Activation, preferably within the FMCG industry

- Experience in Out-of-Home (OOH) channels is considered an advantage.

- Strong trade marketing and shopper marketing knowledge, with a good understanding of in-store execution
